independentLabels: Two independent source reviewers followed by separate adjudication, all before inference. AI labels with a common base-model-family limitation.

execution.retries: No generic retry. Existing bounded context-overflow splitting remains enabled.

controls: Temporary task constraint, not a standing rule

quality.primary: Independent full-proposal support and policy eligibility, including title/body/why/metadata
quality.safeExtraction: Supported AND policy eligible AND passes body/flag/density checks
quality.factCoverage: Credit correct core separately from full-memory safety; coverage does not make unsupported additions safe
quality.negativeCaseFalsePromotion: Any mechanically promotable accepted proposal on a labeled negative input; before dedupe/storage effects
quality.errors: Quote/schema/transport/chunk errors are abstentions, not valid empty answers
quality.rawRejectedProposals: Retained in private call logs. Rejection rates reported separately from accepted-output source grades
quality.noProbabilityMetrics: Generated memory arrays have no equivalent calibrated probability; Brier/ECE are not applicable

interpretation: Legacy versus source changes both delivered evidence and grounding policy; not a causal input-only ablation
Source profiles share the same policy, chunking and output limits
No policy or threshold fitting after cohort freeze
Historical sampling and common-family AI labels cannot establish population guarantees
Any unsafe proposed promotion blocks production acceptance
Passing this small study alone does not authorize production or unattended shadow activation
capacity: Use current idle/capacity evidence and resource guards. MacBook execution requires a verified spare-capacity route; API health alone is insufficient. No admission-floor override or production worker changes.
requiredBeforeActivation: Independent broader held-out quality and downstream utility evidence
